parameters.name: accountKey
parameters.description: The key of the account to retrieve

get.description: Gets a single deposit account. Credit card and pension keys from the account list are not supported.

404.description: Not found when the account key is not matched, or does not belong to the caller

parameters.name: accountKey
parameters.description: The key of the account to retrieve details for

get.description: Gets withdrawal, interest, credit and sharing details for a deposit account. For currency accounts only freeWithdrawalsLeft, blockedBsuAmount, bankIdentifierCode and canBeShared are present.

code.description: A code representing the error that occurred. Can be an application error code if the error might be handled programmatically by the client, or if it shall be possible for the client to show an internationalized message. For I18N messages the code will act as a resource key for the message template in the client. For general errors without an application error code, the code will be a textual representation of the HTTP status code associated with the error. Note: The error code in the example is a general example, and might not be relevant for this API.

message.example: The start date must be after 1970-01-01, and before 2030-12-12. The date should be expressed according to ISO 8601.
message.description: An english error message that describes the error that occurred.

traceId.description: Unique trace id that can be used to correlate the error reported with log entries in SB1

httpCode.description: HTTP status code that describes the error. Can be different from the HTTP status code received by the HTTP client in case a proxy has changed it, or if there are multiple ErrorDTO objects in the HTTP response.

resource.description: If the error is associated with input data, the resource can be set with the property path of the property that contains invalid data

ErrorDTO.description: List of errors. Note: The error in the provided example is a general example, and might not be relevant for this API.

errors.description: List of errors. Note: The error in the provided example is a general example, and might not be relevant for this API.

key.description: The key of the account. Used for further requests towards the account API. For credit cards this is the card id, and for pension agreements the policy number. These keys cannot be used with the other /accounts endpoints.

iban.description: Account IBAN. Empty string for credit card and pension accounts.

name.description: The name of the account. Uses the users preferred name if it exists, falls back to system name if not. For credit cards this is the masked card number, and for pension agreements the agreement name.

type.description:
The account type. Possible values:
        - USER: Local currency deposit user account, including flexi loan accounts (see isFlexiLoan)
        - SAVING: Local currency deposit saving account
        - BSU: Local currency deposit BSU account
        - ELS: Currency deposit loan account
        - IFRS: Local currency IFRS account
        - PENSION: Pension account
        - SAVEAGREE: Local currency savings agreement account
        - STOCKSAVING: Share savings account (aksjesparekonto)
        - TAXWITHDRAW: Local currency tax withdrawal account
        - YEARINTBONUS: Local currency deposit yearly interest bonus account
        - CREDITCARD: Credit card
        - UNKNOWN: Unknown host value

balance.description: The booked balance of the account, in the monetary unit represented by the currency code. The format is the monetary unit followed by . and two digits of cent. The value of cent in this context is one hundredth of the monetary unit. 12.67 in NOK would equal 12 kroners and 67 ore. For pension accounts this is the market value of the agreement.

items.description: DEPRECATED - ALWAYS NULL - List of OBS codes for the account

obsCodes.description: DEPRECATED - ALWAYS NULL - List of OBS codes for the account

productId.description: The product id. Not present for credit card and pension accounts.

description.description: A description of the account. For credit cards this is the card product name. Not present for pension accounts.

productType.description:
The product code for the account. Possible values:
        - LOCDEPOSIT: Local currency deposit.
        - CURDEPOSIT: Currency deposit.
        - UNKNOWN: Unknown host value, and for credit card and pension accounts.

accountNumber.description: The unformatted account number, 11 digits for deposit accounts. For credit cards this is the card account number (prefixed with K), and for pension agreements the policy number prefixed with P.

descriptionCode.description: The description code for the account type

availableBalance.description: The available balance of the account, in the monetary unit represented by the currency code. The format is the monetary unit followed by . and two digits of cent. The value of cent in this context is one hundredth of the monetary unit. 12.67 in NOK would equal 12 kroners and 67 ore. For credit cards this equals balance, and for pension accounts it is always 0.00.

creditCardAccountID.description: ID of the account (AccountId from the backend system KKINT). Present for all credit card accounts. Not present for any other accounts.

creditCardCreditLimit.description: The granted credit limit of the card. Present for all credit card accounts. Not present for any other accounts. In the monetary unit represented by the currency code. The format is the monetary unit followed by . and two digits of cent. The value of cent in this context is one hundredth of the monetary unit. 12.67 in NOK would equal 12 kroners and 67 ore

age.description: The customer's age. Only present when the owner is identified by a national identity number

name.description: The customer's full name, i.e. first name and last name separated by a space

ssnKey.description: The customer's social security number encrypted. A different value will be generated for each call. Only present when the owner is identified by a national identity number

lastName.description: The customer's last name. For corporate customers this is the company name

customerKey.description: The customer's key. Only present when the owner is identified by a national identity number

organisationNumber.description: The customer's 9 digit organisation number. Only present when the owner is identified by an organisation number

CustomerDTO.description: The owner of the account. Not present for credit card and pension accounts.

items.description: Values that can be inserted in a localized error message.

values.description: Values that can be inserted in a localized error message.

template.example: The start date must be after {0}, and before {1}. The date should be expressed according to ISO 8601.
template.description: An english message that indicates how the provided values can be used in a localized error message.

LocalizedMessage.description: Field that can be used in order to build locale specific error messages in the client. code should be used as the key for a I18N message text in the client. localizedMessage is an object containing a template and an array of values can be inserted in the message. The template in localizedMessage is only present in order to indicate the meaning of the elements in the values-array.

creditLine.description: The granted credit line of the account, expressed as a negative amount (or 0 when the account has no credit line). Not present for currency accounts

canBeShared.description: Whether a disposal role may be granted on this account, i.e. it can be shared with another customer. Always false when the logged in user is a minor, and for currency accounts

interestRate.description: The interest rate for the account, in percent. For accounts with balance-tiered rates this is the first reported rate; see interestRatePriceList for all tiers. Not present for currency accounts

blockedAmount.description: An amount that cannot be withdrawn. Not present for currency accounts

blockedBsuAmount.description: DEPRECATED - ALWAYS 0 - The amount set off for BSU that cannot be withdrawn

bankIdentifierCode.description: The bank's international code or address. Used in combination with IBAN to identify an account in context of international payments

lastWithdrawalDate.description: The last day of the current withdrawal period, i.e. the date freeWithdrawalsLeft resets. Not present for accounts without a limit on free withdrawals, or for currency accounts

freeWithdrawalsLeft.description:
The number of free withdrawals remaining in the current withdrawal period (ending on
                lastWithdrawalDate) before a fee is charged.
                Warning: This value is only updated once a day.
                A value of -1 means the account has no limit for the number of free withdrawals.
                Always -1 for currency accounts

totalConfirmedAmount.description: The total reserved amount, i.e. transactions that are approved but not yet booked. Not present for currency accounts

netCalculatedCreditInterest.description: The credit interest earned so far that has not yet been added to the account (capitalized). Not present for currency accounts

totalCreditInterestLastYear.description: The credit interest that was added to the account (capitalized) last year. 0 when there is none. Not present for currency accounts

netCalculatedCreditLineInterest.description: The interest expense on the credit line accrued so far that has not yet been charged (capitalized). 0 when there is none. Not present for currency accounts

toValue.description: The upper bound of the balance interval, exclusive. Not present for the open-ended top interval

fromValue.description: The lower bound of the balance interval, inclusive

interestRate.description: The interest rate that applies within this interval

interestThreshold.description:
How the interest rate for this interval is determined. Possible values:
        - BALANCE: The rate applies because the account's balance falls within this tier of threshold amounts.
        - INTERVAL: The rate is reported per a rate-table interval rather than a balance threshold,
          notably when a tier's rate is lower than the preceding tier's (a "negative threshold" rate).
        - UNKNOWN: The backend did not report a recognized interest threshold type.

InterestIntervalDTO.description: The balance-tiered interest rate intervals for the account

isOwned.description: The user owns the account. At most one of isOwned, userHasRightOfDisposal and userHasRightOfAccess is true

isHidden.description: DEPRECATED - ALWAYS FALSE - The account should be hidden in user interfaces

hasAccess.description: The user has access to the account. Always true, except for pension accounts

isBlocked.description: Access to the account has been blocked

isFlexiLoan.description: The account is a flexiloan account

isBonusAccount.description: DEPRECATED - ALWAYS FALSE - The account is a bonus account

isCodebitorLoan.description: DEPRECATED - ALWAYS FALSE - The account is a codebitor loan

isSavingsAccount.description: The account is a savings account

isAksjesparekonto.description: The account is a share savings account

isSecurityBalance.description: DEPRECATED - ALWAYS FALSE - The account is a security balance

isTransferToEnabled.description: Transfers to the account is enabled

isPaymentFromEnabled.description: Payments from the account is enabled

isWithdrawalsAllowed.description: Withdrawals from the account are allowed. Always true, except for pension accounts

userHasRightOfAccess.description: The user has right of access (read only) to the account, without owning it or having right of disposal. At most one of isOwned, userHasRightOfDisposal and userHasRightOfAccess is true

isAllowedInAvtaleGiro.description: Is allowed as debit account in AvtaleGiro agreements

isTransferFromEnabled.description: Transfers from the account is enabled

userHasRightOfDisposal.description: The user has right of disposal for the account, without owning it. At most one of isOwned, userHasRightOfDisposal and userHasRightOfAccess is true

isDefaultPaymentAccount.description: The account is the users preferred default payment account

isBalanceUpdatedImmediatelyOnTransferTo.description: If true, the account balance is updated immediately when transferring money to the account. If false, the balance will normally be updated within a few hours or days depending on the account type

interestIntervals.description: The balance-tiered interest rate intervals for the account

overdraftInterestRate.description: The interest rate applied to a negative (overdrawn) balance

InterestRatePriceListDTO.description: Interest rates interval price list. Not present for currency accounts
